concerns.text: FR-007 (Leave-one-out cross-validation) is not anchored to any User Story. US-2 describes the meta-analysis and heterogeneity check, but does not explicitly mention influence analysis or leave-one-out validation. This requirement appears to be silent scope creep.

FR-008 (Extract D-coefficients from text/tables) is redundant with FR-001 and FR-004, and while it references US-1, it introduces a specific constraint ('no derivation from raw spectra') that is better placed in Assumptions or FR-004. More critically, it duplicates the retrieval logic without adding a distinct functional capability, creating potential ambiguity in implementation scope.

SC-002 defines specific thresholds (p-value ≥ 0.05, I² ≤ 50%) for validity. While anchored to US-2, these specific numerical thresholds constitute 'pre-asserted values' which the spec template and Constitution (Principle I) advise deferring to the research phase unless derived from a specific standard. However, since it is anchored to a story, it is not an orphan, but the specificity may conflict with the 'deferred' convention for empirical values.
